steps.say: Behcet disease is a variable-vessel systemic vasculitis traveling the ancient Silk Road. Recurrent orogenital aphthosis with ocular inflammation is defining the syndrome. Arteries and veins of all calibers are clotting and bursting together. Ulcers with eyes and clots are marking the road.

vis.caption: Behcet body map: ulcers, eyes, skin, vessels. Scores and doses are in the text, not on the drawing (StewardMD).

steps.say: The 2014 international criteria are scoring six clinical domains. Oral aphthosis with genital aphthosis and ocular lesions is earning 2 points each. Skin lesions with vascular lesions, brain disease, and positive pathergy are earning 1 point each. Four or more points are confirming diagnosis with sensitivity above 94 percent. Points are piling toward four.

steps.say: HLA-B51 is marking genetic susceptibility along the Silk Road. The B5101 subtype is found in 50 to 80 percent of cases stretching from the Middle East to Japan. Risk of disease is multiplying 5 to 6 fold in carriers. Genes are clustering along the caravan route.

steps.say: The pathergy reaction is testing cutaneous hyperreactivity with a needle. A sterile 20 to 22 gauge prick in the forearm is raising the lesion. An erythematous papule or sterile pustule of 2 mm or more is appearing with a red halo. Reading at 24 to 48 hours is completing the test. Needles are raising pustules in a day or two.

steps.say: Ocular disease is striking 50 to 70 percent of Behcet patients. Recurrent non-granulomatous panuveitis with retinal vasculitis is flaring in attacks. Sterile hypopyon is layering white cells in the front chamber and shifting with gravity. Untreated attacks are stealing vision permanently. Pus layers are shifting while vision is fading.

steps.say: Angio-Behcet is clotting vessels in up to 40 percent of patients. Veins are suffering far more than arteries. Superficial thrombophlebitis with deep vein thrombosis, Budd-Chiari blockade, and vena cava syndrome are filling the venous list. Pulmonary artery aneurysms are standing as the arterial hallmark and killing by hemoptysis on rupture. Veins are clotting while aneurysms are bursting.

steps.say: Neuro-Behcet is affecting 5 to 10 percent of patients in two patterns. Parenchymal brainstem and diencephalic encephalitis with meningoencephalitis is carrying a grim prognosis. Venous sinus thrombosis without parenchymal lesions is raising intracranial pressure with papilledema. Parenchyma is inflaming while sinuses are clotting.

steps.say: Severe disease is demanding steroids with immunosuppressants or biologics. Posterior uveitis with pulmonary aneurysms and neuro-Behcet is meeting the severe rule. Intravenous cyclophosphamide with infliximab or adalimumab is joining high-dose steroids. Lone anticoagulation is rupturing aneurysms into bronchi. Immune drugs are saving while thinners alone are betraying.
